{{Quote|Where is Dina? Where is she? What have you done with her!?|A victim of the White Thranta Shipping Company|<ref name="SWG:DI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Digital Infection|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Dina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dina was captured by henchmen of the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]]. The organization was actually serving as a front for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], kidnapping victims and infecting them for deranged experiments. Most of the "subjects" did not survive the experiments.<ref name="SWG:DI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigated the [[White Thranta Shipping offices]] and found dying prisoners. One such victim withered on the ground, shouting in anguish about an individual named Dina.<ref name="SWG:DI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dina was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:DI" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dina was mentioned by the prisoners in the White Thranta Shipping bunker,<ref name="SWG:DI" /> added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
